name: the PDF and Word readers, the reader seam and the conformance kit

mutants.name: 8a seam: the host refuses any seam version other than its own, so a reader built for version 1 no longer loads
8b containment: the connector's Complete callback is contained with the reader, so its defect is blamed on the file
mutants.new: try { return SourceRead.Ok(content.Complete(read, hash)); } catch (Exception ex) { return SourceRead.Failed(content.Path, ex.Message); }

mutants.name: 8c containment: a reader that throws ends the run again
mutants.old: catch (Exception ex) when (ex is not OperationCanceledException || !ct.IsCancellationRequested)
mutants.new: catch (Exception ex) when (false && (ex is not OperationCanceledException || !ct.IsCancellationRequested))

mutants.name: 8d skip: a reader's skip reason is ignored and the file is indexed as empty text
8aj kit: with nothing overridden the kit gives no unreadable item
8ak kit: the fake holds nothing unreadable
mutants.old: yield return SourceRead.Unread(content with { Open = _ => throw new IOException(Reason) });

mutants.name: 8al kit: the kit is stamped with a version of its own instead of the product version
8an kit: a kit for another seam version is never a mismatch
8o pdf: the test process references the reader, so it holds a PdfPig the host would take instead of the folder's
